Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Suresh - 42 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Hema and Suresh stand near him.]

Suresh: "What lovely weather!"

[Ishaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Ishaan does his homework at the table.]

Suresh (laughing): "Hema, listen!"

[Ishaan slams the door shut.]

Ishaan: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Hema: "Ishaan, look over here."

[It starts to rain.]

Ishaan: "And then?"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Hema: "Yes, all right."

[Hailstones start falling.]

Ishaan (excited): "And then?"

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Hema: "What a day to remember!"
